cards.ex: After the transplant, he felt like he had a new lease on life.
cards.exUz: Ko'chirib o'tkazishdan keyin u o'zini yangi hayotga ega bo'lgandek his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Og'ir kasallikdan so'ng yangi imkoniyatga ega bo'lish, sog'ayib ketish.

cards.ex: He was at death's door with pneumonia, but he pulled through.
cards.exUz: U pnevmoniya bilan o'lim yoqasida edi, lekin tuzalib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda og'ir kasal bo'lib, o'lishga yaqin bo'lish.

cards.ex: She's always been a picture of health, exercising every day and eating well.
cards.exUz: U har doim sog'lik timsoli bo'lgan, har kuni mashq qilib, yaxshi ovqatlanadi.

cards.ex: I'm starting to feel my age; I can't run as fast as I used to.
cards.exUz: Men yoshimni his qila boshladim; men avvalgidek tez yugura olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Qarilik tufayli charchoq va kasalliklarni his qilish.

cards.ex: I need to go on vacation to recharge my batteries after this stressful project.
cards.exUz: Bu stressli loyihadan keyin kuch yig'ish uchun ta'tilga borishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Dam olish orqali kuch va energiya tiklash.

cards.ex: It's not easy to kick the habit of smoking, but it's worth it.
cards.exUz: Chekish odatidan voz kechish oson emas, lekin bunga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon odatdan butunlay voz kechish, tashlash.

cards.ex: We need to nip this illness in the bud before it spreads to others.
cards.exUz: Biz bu kasallikni boshqalarga tarqalishidan oldin ildizini quritishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: High blood pressure runs in my family; both my parents have it.
cards.exUz: Yuqori qon bosimi mening oilamda nasldan o'tadi; ota-onamning ikkalasida ham bor.
cards.uzDef: Odatda kasallik yoki xususiyat, oila a'zolarida bo'lish.

cards.ex: It took him a while to get back on his feet after the accident.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan keyin oyoqqa turishi uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan so'ng sog'ayib, normal hayotga qaytish.

cards.ex: She's finally on the road to recovery after her surgery.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat operatsiyadan keyin tuzalish yo'lida.
cards.uzDef: Sog'ayish jarayonida bo'lish, tuzalish sari ketish.

cards.ex: He was a shadow of his former self after the long illness.
cards.exUz: U uzoq davom etgan kasallikdan keyin o'zidan soyasi edi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan so'ng avvalgi holatida emaslik, zaiflashgan.

cards.ex: We're fighting a losing battle trying to keep the hospital open with such limited funding.
cards.exUz: Biz bunday cheklangan mablag 'bilan kasalxonani ochiq saqlashga harakat qilib befoyda kurashmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish imkoni yo'q bo'lgan vaziyatda kurashish.

cards.ex: The kids are always full of beans, even after a long day at school.
cards.exUz: Bolalar har doim shodumon, hatto maktabda uzoq kundan keyin ham.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p energiya va g'ayratga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The star player is out of action for several weeks with a knee injury.
cards.exUz: Yulduz o'yinchi tizza jarohati tufayli bir necha hafta safdan chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Jarohat yoki kasallik tufayli ishlay olmaslik.

cards.ex: My grandmother is 85 and still as fit as a fiddle.
cards.exUz: Mening buvim 85 yoshda, lekin hali ham juda sog'lom.

cards.ex: The doctor couldn't turn a blind eye to the patient's obvious symptoms.
cards.exUz: Shifokor bemorning aniq alomatlariga ko'rmaslikka ololmadi.

cards.ex: The stress of the job started to take its toll on her health.
cards.exUz: Ishning stressi uning sog'lig'iga ta'sir qila boshladi.

cards.ex: Losing the election was a bitter pill to swallow.
cards.exUz: Saylovda mag'lub bo'lish qabul qilish qiyin bo'lgan narsa edi.

cards.ex: I've been working like a dog all week to finish this project.
cards.exUz: Men bu loyihani tugatish uchun butun hafta quldek ishladim.

cards.ex: The new treatment offers a ray of hope for cancer patients.
cards.exUz: Yangi davolash usuli saraton kasalligiga chalingan bemorlar uchun umid nuri beradi.

cards.ex: His condition was touch and go for a few days after the surgery.
cards.exUz: Operatsiyadan keyin uning ahvoli bir necha kun noaniq edi.

cards.ex: She's been burning the candle at both ends to finish her PhD.
cards.exUz: U doktorlik dissertatsiyasini tugatish uchun juda ko'p vaqt va energiya sarflamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p vaqt va energiya sarflash.

cards.ex: It's just a shot in the dark, but it might work.
cards.exUz: Bu shunchaki ko'r-ko'rona urinish, lekin ish berishi mumkin.

cards.ex: I'm at my wit's end trying to figure out what's wrong with my car.
cards.exUz: Men mashinamdagi muammoni aniqlashga urinib hayron qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qila olmaslikdan xafa bo'lish.

cards.ex: She had to go under the knife to repair her knee.
cards.exUz: Tizzasini tuzatish uchun jarrohlik ostida o'tishi kerak edi.

cards.ex: I didn't want to go to the dentist, but I had to bite the bullet.
cards.exUz: Men stomatologga borishni xohlamadim, lekin tishni tishga bosishim kerak edi.

cards.ex: The new investment was a real shot in the arm for the company.
cards.exUz: Yangi investitsiya kompaniya uchun katta yordam bo'ldi.
cards.term: a real shot in the arm

cards.ex: After his illness, he decided to turn over a new leaf and start living a healthier lifestyle.
cards.exUz: Kasalligidan so'ng u yangi sahifa ochishga va sog'lom turmush tarzini boshlashga qaror qildi.

cards.ex: Vitamin C can help boost your immune system.
cards.exUz: S vitamini immunitet tizimini kuchaytirishga yordam beradi.

cards.ex: I try to stick to my regular exercise routine.
cards.exUz: Men muntazam mashqlar odatimga rioya qilishga harakat qilaman.
